name: Tati
summary: Owner/manager of "Sami." — a high-touch household concierge and cleaning company (her mother Delia is the on-site housekeeper) — that served Derrek's apartment from May to September 2026. She is a vendor, not a client of any ALTR business line: she handled cleaning, laundry, dog care/grooming, groceries, meal-prep proposals (tatimeals.com), furniture assembly, storage organization, and even processed controller/model-management reimbursements, billing Derrek via Stripe/Zelle on a biweekly-then-monthly retainer. The relationship blew up on 2026-09-28 when the invoice jumped to ~$5K/month without notice, allegedly because Isabella "joined the family"; Derrek disputed the charges, called her and Alex scammers, and cancelled the service on the spot. Status: terminated and hostile — Derrek told her to pull Delia from the house immediately and threatened public press over Alex's conduct toward him, Ale, and Tati.
